definitions.gloss: old town; old quarter; historic district of a city
definitions.explanation: The older, historic part of a city, usually with narrow streets and old buildings, as distinct from the newer districts that grew up around it. Common in travel writing about European and Asian cities.

examples.japanese: {旧市街|きゅうしがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk around the old town.

examples.japanese: {旧市街|きゅうしがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界遺産|せかいいさん}→世界遺産：04897_sekaiisan⟧だ。
examples.english: The old town is a World Heritage Site.

examples.japanese: {旧市街|きゅうしがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{石畳|いしだたみ}→石畳：08398_ishidatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていて→残る：01187_nokoru⟧、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The old town still has narrow cobbled lanes that cars can't enter.

notes:
⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧ (old, former) + ⟦{市街|しがい}→市街：12468_shigai⟧ (city streets). Its counterpart is {新市街|しんしがい}, the new town.

- {旧市街|きゅうしがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散策|さんさく}→散策：07618_sansaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stroll through the old town
